comment: How a job must end when makemkvcon's mkv command prints each fixture, exits with exitCode and (writesFile) leaves an output file behind. Every platform's tests replay these through the job pipeline with a stand-in makemkvcon. rip-disk-full, rip-killed (SIGTERM mid-write), rip-missing-source and rip-missing-title are real makemkvcon 2.0 output; rip-failure and rip-read-errors add read-error messages (as a scratched disc produces) to real output.
